posts.name: Shibin Mohammed N P
posts.cooked:
Hi SC Team, I encountered a problem during yesterday’s System Commands OPPE, I was not able to move past the camera access popup, even after granting permission for it. So I’m not sure whether my presence has been marked or not. I had informed the proctor about this and he tried to help me with it, but it wasn’t successful either. He did informed this with the technical team. I kindly request you to give me another chance on the coming re OPPE this weekend. I have already raised a ticket regarding the same. @sayan @AtulPS @Afnan_POD @hemalatha @Puneet_21f3002005 @21f1002877 @chaitanya353535

Screenshot 2025-08-16 2112501919×1079 255 KB
